visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a small green hairclip is shown in a close-up shot. She wears a white collared shirt under a black apron with a red 'aotter' logo. She smiles widely, showing her teeth, and waves her hand excitedly toward the camera against a vibrant red background. (2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit indoor cafe environment. The woman stands behind a black counter with a digital menu screen in the background. She gestures toward a middle-aged male customer holding a smartphone. A second female staff member stands further back. (3) The woman walks through a marketplace or event hall. Tables are crowded with diverse items like handbags, toy boxes, and plushies. She carries a drink and interacts with various male and female attendees. The background features event posters and a large projection screen. (4) The woman stands beside a white gashapon machine. She turns the metal handle, retrieves a red plastic capsule, and pulls out a small paper slip. She reacts with high-intensity laughter, doubling over as she looks at the camera. The setting is a brightly lit retail space with shelves of merchandise.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin with an excited, high-pitched intonation. A bright electronic pop background track with a strong 4/4 beat is playing simultaneously. A sudden digital 'pop' sound effect marks a visual transition. (2) As the speaker interacts with a customer, the female voice remains prominent with high arousal. A male voice with a lower, calmer pitch is heard briefly in response. A 'ding' UI sound effect coincides with the appearance of on-screen variety text. (3) During the marketplace walkthrough, the background music continues at a consistent tempo. Ambient chatter and muffled laughter from the crowd are layered under the main speech. Several 'whoosh' sound effects are used to punctuate fast camera movements and edits. (4) The final segment features the distinct mechanical sound of a gashapon machine turning and a plastic capsule hitting the tray. The speaker lets out a loud, genuine laugh with high spectral brightness, followed by a celebratory comic 'ta-da' style sound effect as she reveals the prize.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Grand Reopening' event of a collaborative space between Aotter and Nespresso. The video uses a charismatic 'one-day manager' persona to showcase the various activities available, such as the cafe, the second-hand market, and gashapon prizes, aiming to attract visitors through a fun, high-energy atmosphere.
